disease_label_per_paper: Coronary artery spasm due to acute myocarditis in an adolescent
presentation_summary: 15-year-old boy developed sudden repeated left parasternal chest pain after a 3-day flu-like illness.
He later developed chest pain with dyspnea and presented to the emergency room.
Vitals at transfer included blood pressure 110/70 mmHg, heart rate 86 bpm, respiratory rate 15/min, temperature 38.5 C, and oxygen saturation 99% on room air.
ECG showed ST-segment elevation in inferior and precordial leads; high-sensitivity troponin I rose to 21,538.68 pg/mL.
Echocardiography showed LVEF 66.04% with very mild anteroseptal hypokinesis.
